note: N-P19 probes B1 premise P-06c (close order at a terminate-like end). Setup: JOB with a caller transaction, 'load m -DNoJournal=1' where m depends on d1, d1's Activate stalls, then $SYSTEM.Process.Terminate. d1's twin insert and any persist made while journaling is disabled cannot be rolled back (P-03, N-P07). If live objects close innermost first (P-06c), d1's log persists before the top JournalManager re-enables journaling, so d1's row survives finalized. If the top JournalManager closed first, the persist would be journaled and rolled back, leaving d1's row unfinalized.

N-P19.claim: At a terminate-like end, live objects close innermost frame first: the dependency's log, then the top load's JournalManager, then the top log (B1 P-06c).

binding.invoke.tlevel.source: harness: only the caller's level is open (NoJournal starts no transaction)

history.dep1.row.source: P-03 / N-P07 (twin insert made with journaling disabled is not undone)

history.dep1.finalized.source: P-06c (dependency log closes while journaling is still disabled)

history.top.row.source: P-01, P-05 (top Init insert was journaled inside the caller transaction and is rolled back)
